title: SuffixArrayBuilder is reached from SuffixArray::build
body:
`SuffixArrayBuilder` (`libsufr/src/build.rs:36`) is reached through its own constructors, `from_sequence_file(path, delimiter)` and `from_data(text, sequences)`, and finished with `build_to_file(path, low_memory) -> Result<SuffixArray>`. `SuffixArray` (`lib.rs`) has `open` and `open_with` but no way to start a build, so a user learns two entry points for one type.

## Proposal

`SuffixArray::build(..)` returns the builder, so a build reads as `SuffixArray::build(..).with_dna_options(..).build_to_file(..)`. Whether `SuffixArrayBuilder` keeps any public constructor of its own is open; the builder may be a type a user only ever receives.

## Open

- What `build` takes: the path, the text and sequences, or one call per source.
- Whether `from_sequence_file` and `from_data` stay public, become `pub(crate)`, or go.

This waits on the builder redesign that separates configuration from construction, since that decides what the builder's surface is.
